claim_boundary: This artifact proves only the conditional finite labelled escape localization lemma. It does not establish an actual coefficient partition, a comb-norm majorant, positive transport, a bounded fan, a moment, density, or intervals.

finite_labelled_escape_localization.boundary: this localizes an assumed finite labelled escape projection and a frozen comb-norm bound; it does not prove the partition, bound the class, or prove a full moment, density, or intervals
finite_labelled_escape_localization.finite_class_pigeonhole: if -Re<F,w_h>/W_h>=kappa and F is an additive partition into J labelled classes, one class has negative normalized projection at least kappa/J
finite_labelled_escape_localization.label_retention: the chosen class retains its frozen escape reason and all coefficient, rational-tail, and payload labels
finite_labelled_escape_localization.one_ray_l2: if the frozen comb norm satisfies ||w_h||_2^2<=A W_h with fixed A, Cauchy turns a class projection at least (kappa/J)W_h into L2 norm squared at least (kappa/J)^2 W_h/A

remaining_target.statement: derive or reject the actual finite coefficient-escape partition and fixed comb-norm majorant; then analyze the selected class or prove O_kappa(1) positive fixed-phase transport
